purpose.intended_use: Real-time probability that a payment or account transaction is fraudulent, used to approve, step-up, review or decline before funds move.
out_of_scope: AML transaction monitoring / SAR decisions (separate typologies and regulation)
Sole basis for account closure without human review
purpose.decision_type: Decision support with automated action under documented policy thresholds

regulatory_mapping.scope: Model risk management principles for banks
Annex III 5(b) exempts AI used to detect financial fraud from the high-risk credit-scoring category; GDPR Art. 22 still applies to solely automated decisions

Synthetic generator adds +60 when it creates a fraud (src/01_data_generation.py)

methodology.categorical_encoding: Smoothed fraud rate per category (m=50), out-of-fold on the training window; applied as a fitted parameter at inference
methodology.threshold_policy: Reference threshold = 2% alert budget on the calibration window

legacy_benchmark.note: Legacy composite weights label-derived risk_score at 35%; figures are not valid evidence of performance and are shown only to document the leakage.

fairness.note: Evaluated at the reference threshold and at looser 5% / 10% alert budgets, where legitimate customers are flagged, so the test is informative even when the reference point has no false positives.

reference.method: False-positive-rate parity with two-proportion z-test; approval adverse impact ratio

stress_5pct_budget.method: False-positive-rate parity with two-proportion z-test; approval adverse impact ratio

stress_10pct_budget.method: False-positive-rate parity with two-proportion z-test; approval adverse impact ratio

plan.population_stability: Score PSI and per-feature CSI weekly; investigate >= 0.10, escalate >= 0.25
plan.performance: ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, VDR on labels older than the 90-day maturity window, monthly
plan.calibration: Recalibrate when OOT ECE exceeds 0.02 on matured labels
plan.revalidation: Full independent revalidation annually or on material change

gates.detail: All model features trace to pre-authorisation fields

limitations: Trained on synthetic data; performance must be re-established on the bank's own labelled history before production use.
FX amounts use indicative reference rates unless overridden with the bank's official rate feed.
The synthetic customer base has ~6 transactions per customer, so velocity features are sparse; their contribution will be larger on real transaction streams.
Labels are taken at face value; production labels need a maturity window (chargebacks arrive 30-120 days after the transaction) before performance is measured.
historical_average_transaction_amount is a profile field supplied by the source system and must be maintained point-in-time to avoid look-ahead.
